title: When the delta is fake: Three public agent-eval tasks with nop starters, frozen controls, and a scored fail trace
description:
Technical note and public mini-suite on agent-evaluation craft. Ships three tasks (clearing-hold-ledger, slot-ring-buffer, site-shift-meter) with named starter failures, oracle solutions, verifiers that recompute scores from artifacts, calibration notes, a site-shift case study (why mean-only adaptation can leave ranking AUROC unchanged), and a scored staged-fail trace rubric.

Designed against the Terminal-Bench task shape (instruction, environment, outcome tests, oracle) and usable next to Harbor / Inspect-style harnesses. Synthetic fixtures only. Not a leaderboard.

Reproduce: pytest -q -p no:randomly tasks/*/tests then python3 tasks/site-shift-meter/solution/train_and_eval.py.
notes: Author: Gyanu Mayank (B.Tech CSE, NIT Patna; Pune, India). Contact: gyanumayank0@gmail.com. Prefer the concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23829461 when citing (resolves to the latest version).
